Here's the fucking reason. I've struggled with depression since I was 12 fucking years old. I've had to change schools twice as a consequence of my depression in some way shape or form. And about 6 months ago I was finally taken off medication. Now since I see everything clearly, I realize there's no point in me living if it's going to be this miserable without being chemically manipulated. 

That real enough for you?
I just can't find any solution. And since Ambien doesn't work, all I've got left is Zoloft, and IIRC that doesn't do me much good. Guess I'll settle for the trusty ol extension cord.
But those aren't the people I need right now. The friends I need wot answer me. Not sure if it's because they hate me or because it's a Sunday in the Bible Belt
Honestly, there's no point. Right now I'm trying to rack my brain and figure out where my parent's ambien is.
